name: SpotDraft
description_en:
SpotDraft is a hosted contract lifecycle management platform for in-house legal and business teams. It combines templates, negotiation, approvals, signing, a repository and reporting, with AI capabilities across that lifecycle.

Workflow Manager makes an important distinction between a contract generated from an approved template and third-party paper supplied by a counterparty. Those routes require different intake and review logic. VerifAI, Clickwrap and Legal Hub also appear in the product family; the catalogue does not assume a single CLM quote includes every adjacent product.
description_zh:
SpotDraft 是供企业内部法务及业务团队使用的托管合同生命周期管理平台，结合模板、谈判、审批、签署、合同库和报表，并在生命周期内加入 AI 能力。

Workflow Manager 区分从批准模板生成的合同与对方提供的第三方合同，两种路径需要不同的申请和审阅逻辑。产品家族另有 VerifAI、Clickwrap 和 Legal Hub，本文不假定一份 CLM 报价包含全部相邻产品。

sections.title_en: Review a vendor contract using an intake form
sections.title_zh: 用申请表审阅供应商合同
sections.en: For a vendor-supplied agreement, collect business context with a Third-Party Paper Workflow instead of pretending the file came from your approved template. The documented intake forms capture required information alongside the upload, then custom rules route reviews and approvals. Check a missing vendor detail and a material value change before approving the process. The workflow should preserve the actual counterparty version, not merely the questionnaire answers.
sections.zh: 对供应商提供的协议，可用 Third-Party Paper Workflow 收集业务背景，而不是视为自家批准模板生成的文件。文档描述上传时通过申请表收集必要信息，再按规则路由审阅和审批。启用前可检查供应商资料缺失及重大金额变更。流程应保留实际对方版本，而不只是问卷回答。

sections.title_en: Keep template generation separate from negotiation
sections.en: Template Workflows generate contracts using approved dynamic templates and questionnaire data. The workflow page also describes starting from Salesforce or HubSpot and pre-populating deal details. A generated draft is not the same as an approved negotiated version; test what happens when a counterparty changes a clause or an internal field after generation. Confirm the precise connector and object scope rather than inferring all CRM operations are supported.
sections.zh: Template Workflows 以批准的动态模板和问卷数据生成合同；流程页还描述从 Salesforce 或 HubSpot 发起并预填交易资料。生成草稿不同于批准后的谈判版本，应测试对方修改条款或生成后内部字段变化的处理。具体连接器和对象范围需确认，不能推断支持全部 CRM 操作。

sections.title_en: Contract-volume quote with included implementation positioning
sections.title_zh: 按合同量询价，并核对实施包含范围
sections.en: The current pricing page says plans are based on contract volume and describes in-house implementation, workflow/integration setup and migration as included without an extra implementation fee. It also advertises a dedicated customer-success contact and round-the-clock support. No numeric public payable subscription amount was verified. Obtain the volume definition, product scope and included migration deliverables in writing; the marketing statement does not settle an unlimited custom project.
sections.zh: 当前定价页说明按合同量制定方案，并把内部团队实施、流程／集成配置及迁移列为包含、不额外收实施费，还介绍专属客户成功及全天支持。未核实公开订阅金额。应书面确认合同量定义、产品范围和包含的迁移交付；营销说明不能理解为无限定制项目。

sections.title_en: Configure access and exception handling before rollout
sections.title_zh: 上线前配置权限及例外处理
sections.en: Prepare the approved templates, intake fields, reviewer groups and legacy agreement set. Compare restricted access, a rejected approval and an amended contract in the intended workflow. AI review and metadata extraction require comparison against source agreements; no extraction count or speed figure was benchmarked here. The site presents a hosted service; self-hosting, open-source licensing and recovery/exit commitments remain unverified.
sections.zh: 应准备批准模板、申请字段、审阅组及历史协议集，再在目标流程中核对受限访问、审批拒绝和补充协议。AI 审阅及元数据提取需与原协议对照；本文未测试字段提取数量或速度。网站呈现托管服务，自托管、开源许可及恢复退出承诺仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Choose when legal intake needs a repeatable process
sections.title_zh: 适合需要可重复法务申请流程的团队
sections.en: In-house legal teams receiving both standard requests and third-party agreements have a clear evaluation case. A small signature-only use case may not need full workflow administration. Compare the package against the actual mix of generated, uploaded, renewed and amended agreements, since these may affect the quoted contract-volume model. This profile does not certify legal enforceability or a hands-on deployment.
sections.zh: 内部法务同时接收标准申请和第三方合同时，有明确评估场景。只需少量签署的任务可能无需完整流程管理。应按生成、上传、续约和补充协议的实际组合核对套餐，因为它们可能影响报价中的合同量模型。本文不认证法律效力，也不声称完成部署实测。
